title: FA Workflow
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare normalization CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file containing the normalization parameters with the exact header line: "sample number,sample name,sample concentration (<0.25 mg/ml)". For each sample, list the sample number, the sample name (e.g., 007007009-403-1) and its measured concentration (e.g., 1.569). Use a 2‑fold dilution to reach the desired final concentration and plan to aliquot each normalized sample in triplicate. Example rows: 1,007007009-403-1,1.569; 2,007007009-403-2,0.984; 3,007007009-403-3,2.128; 4,007007009-403-4,2.413; 5,007007009-403-5,2.303; 6,007007009-403-6,1.541; 7,007007009-403-7,2.404; 8,007007009-403-8,2.352; 9,007007009-403-9,2.763; 10,007007009-403-10,1.763; 11,007007009-403-11,2.094; 12,007007009-403-12,0.906; 13,007007009-403-13,0.715.

steps.title: Download CSV template
steps.instruction: If desired, download the ready‑made template from https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/4568fa/ex.csv and edit it with your sample data.

steps.title: Upload custom labware JSON
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware, and select any required labware definition files (must have a .json extension).

steps.title: Upload protocol Python file
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, navigate to the Protocol tab and upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map before running the protocol.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette. Consult the app’s support articles for detailed calibration instructions if needed.
